{{Quote|The aftermath is Ter Abbes's problem.|«[[Nom Anor|Udelen]]» convincing [[Goran Beviin]] to kill Ter Abbes's [[Tholote B'Leph|politician]]|<ref name="PM" />}}
Prior to the start of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Nom Anor]], in disguise, hired the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Goran Beviin]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Tholote B'Leph]], an important politician on the planet [[Ter Abbes]]. His [[Death/Legends|death]] escalated tensions, resulting in a '''civil war''' on Ter Abbes that lasted for a [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. The effectiveness of the Mandalorians impressed Nom Anor, who concluded that they could be valuable allies for the upcoming [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invasion.

==History==
===Orchestration of chaos===
{{Quote|What's he [Tholote B'Leph] done?''"<br />"''He takes bribes.''"<br />"''No, I mean what's he done that all the others haven't?''"<br />"''He hasn't delivered on his promises.|Goran Beviin and «Udelen»|<ref name="PM" />}}
Before the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species, [[Nom Anor]] had served for nearly two decades as their [[Intendant caste|infiltrator]], spying on the inhabitants of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] and destabilizing its political structure.<ref name="NGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> During the fifth [[Standard month/Legends|month]] of [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], Nom Anor continued to patiently prepare the future battlefield to ease the path for his people's army while also seeking useful allies. In pursuit of these goals, he decided to incite riots across the industrial planet [[Ter Abbes]], which was located off the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]<ref name="PM" /> within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Ter Abbes system/Legends|Ter Abbes system]]</ref>

As part of his plan, Nom Anor, using the alias Udelen, hired the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Goran Beviin]] to assassinate [[Tholote B'Leph]],<ref name="PM" /> the corrupt leader of the opposition party,<ref name="CE" /> prior to the following month's elections on Ter Abbes. For the job, Nom Anor offered one hundred thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], on the condition that the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] take place a few [[Standard day/Legends|days]] before the election. Although Goran Beviin briefly considered the civil unrest it would cause, he accepted Anor's offer, assuming that the mysterious client was most likely involved in a coup on Ter Abbes.<ref name="PM" />

Eventually, Goran Beviin carried out Nom Anor's assignment with the required efficiency. The [[Death/Legends|death]] of Tholote B'Leph escalated tensions on Ter Abbes and resulted in a civil war<ref name="PM" /><ref name="CE" /> that lasted for the following [[Standard year/Legends|year]].<ref name="CE" />

===Aftermath===
{{Quote|Goran Beviin did an efficient job of removing B'Leph, and a civil war is still in progress. He recruits equally efficient comrades: even their [Mandalorian] children are savage fighters.|Nom Anor's intelligence report to [[Prefect (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Prefect]] [[Da'Gara]]|<ref name="PM" />}}
In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], eight [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the beginning of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|Yuuzhan Vong invasion]], Nom Anor sent an intelligence report to [[Prefect (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Prefect]] [[Da'Gara]],<ref name="PM" /> the leader<ref name="NJOS">''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]''</ref> of the [[Praetorite Vong|first conquest force]],<ref name="CEI">{{CSWECite|I|161|Da'Gara, Prefect}}</ref> in which he emphasized the usefulness of the Mandalorians for infiltration, retrieval, assassination, and sabotage. Later that year, Nom Anor recruited a group of Mandalorian warriors led by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to carry out [[Battle of Birgis|covert]] [[Battle of New Holgha|missions]] on behalf of the Yuuzhan Vong forces.<ref name="PM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The civil war on Ter Abbes and the planet itself were first mentioned in ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]'', a [[2006]] [[eBook]] written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="PM" /> The conflict's duration was later revealed in a brief entry on [[Tholote B'Leph]] published in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CE" />
